Title: MemorySmith.Agent — Emergency Stop System
Content:
Emergency stop (StopNow) bypasses the command queue and clears adapter state immediately. It is the highest-priority control path in the system.

## C# Side (AgentBackgroundService.cs SendEmergencyStop, line 3491)

SendEmergencyStop:
1. Creates ActionData with action='stop', correlationId=new Guid()
2. Calls _queue.ClearAndEnqueueAsync(stopAction, ct) — clears all pending actions AND enqueues stop
   - ClearAndEnqueueAsync (line ~1182): first calls stop callback (async) for any in-flight action, THEN lock-protected clear + enqueue
3. For each item in _correlatedActions:
   - Transitions Dispatched → TimedOut via CAS TryUpdate
4. Clears _placeBlockContexts (lines ~340, ~410)
5. Sets _actionDispatchedThisCycle = false
6. Disposes _goalProvisioningCts if active (line 244 declaration, cancelled at line ~362 before new provisioning, and at line ~399 in CancelGoal)

ClearAndEnqueueAsync contract:
- Async stop callback is called BEFORE lock to prevent deadlock (callback may need to await something)
- After callback: lock() { _queue.Clear(); _queue.Enqueue(stopAction); }
- This ordering ensures the in-flight action's cleanup runs before the queue is cleared

## Selective CancelGoal (Sprint 43 P0-3)

CancelGoal (line 385) now selectively stops based on goal type:
- Conflicting goals (gather, build, craft): calls SendEmergencyStop (line 388)
- Idle/wander goals: just clears queue + correlation tracking without emergency stop (line ~1513-1520)
- This prevents unnecessary adapter queue flushes when the bot is already idle
- Also cancels _goalProvisioningCts (line 399) to prevent provisioning continuation

## Goal Provisioning CTS (Sprint 58 Wave D TSK-0331)

- _goalProvisioningCts: private CancellationTokenSource? (line 244)
- Created/assigned in SetGoal path (line 364) when creative provisioning is active
- Cancelled (line 362) and disposed (line 363) before new provisioning starts
- Cancelled in CancelGoal (line 399)
- Passed to provisioning loop as linked token with _connectionCts.Token (line 368-369)
- Prevents provisioning loop from continuing after goal change, preventing orphaned async operations

## Node.js Side (MineflayerAdapter/index.js handleStop)

handleStop:
1. Sets _stopRequested = true (observed by drainQueue and active handlers)
2. Clears cmdQueue via cmdQueue.length = 0
3. Stops pathfinder: bot.pathfinder.stop()
4. Cancels digging: bot.stopDigging() (if currently digging)
5. Sends stopComplete event back via WebSocket
6. Calls nextAction() to resume queue processing

## Guard Pattern in Active Handlers

All long-running handlers (dig, goto, craft, smelt) check _stopRequested periodically:
- Before each dig() call: if (_stopRequested) return sendEvent('mineAborted', ...)
- In pathfinder goto success/failure callbacks: if (_stopRequested) return sendEvent('mineAborted', ...)
- In craft loop: check between each crafting iteration
- In smelt loop: check before each furnace interaction

## Complete Flow

C# StopNow → WebSocket 'stop' message → Node.js handleStop:
1. C#: _queue.ClearAndEnqueueAsync → clears all pending actions with async stop callback
2. C#: CAS-transitions all Dispatched → TimedOut
3. C#: clears _placeBlockContexts
4. C#: disposes _goalProvisioningCts if active
5. WebSocket: sends {action:"stop"} to Node.js
6. Node.js: handleStop → sets _stopRequested, clears cmdQueue, stops pathfinder, cancels dig
7. Node.js: sends stopComplete event → C# marks complete

## Emergency Stop Call Sites

- SetGoal (new goal replaces old): calls SendEmergencyStop (line ~388)
- CancelGoal for conflicting goals: calls SendEmergencyStop (line 388 path)
- Selective CancelGoal for idle/wander: skips emergency stop (Sprint 43)
